name: file-explorer
title: File explorer
description: A filing cabinet: the places are the tabs of a manila folder, and inside one you open folders with a trail back, switch between a list and a grid, sort, search, pick several files and delete them (with an Undo). Files are named to a screen reader with their kind, size and date. Made for the desk, where the folder's kraft looks right.

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]

export function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < KB) return `${Math.round(bytes)} B`
  if (bytes < MB) return `${Math.round(bytes / KB)} KB`
  const mb = bytes / MB
  return `${mb >= 100 ? Math.round(mb) : Math.round(mb * 10) / 10} MB`
}

export function formatDay(iso: string): string {
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-")
  return `${MONTHS[Number(m) - 1] ?? m} ${Number(d)}${y === "2026" ? "" : `, ${y}`}`
}

export function withDescendants(list: readonly FileNode[], id: string): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>([id])
  let grew = true
  while (grew) {
    grew = false
    for (const n of list) if (!out.has(n.id) && out.has(n.parent)) (out.add(n.id), (grew = true))
  }
  return out
}

export const countIn = (list: readonly FileNode[], id: string): number => list.filter((n) => n.parent === id).length
